text: yadidaṃ dhammānukampāti . dānavaggo tatiyo 1 [396] 150 devame bhikkhave santhārā katame deva āmisasanthāro ca dhammasanthāro ca ime kho bhikkhave deva santhārā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ santhārānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasanthāroti . [397] 151 devame bhikkhave paṭisanthārā katame deva āmisapaṭisanthāro ca dhammapaṭisanthāro ca ime kho bhikkhave deva paṭisanthārā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ paṭisanthārānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapaṭisanthāroti . [398] 152 devamā bhikkhave esanā katamā deva āmisesanā ca dhammesanā ca imā kho bhikkhave deva esanā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ esanānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammesanāti . [399] 153 devamā bhikkhave pariyesanā katamā deva āmisapariyesanā ca dhammapariyesanā ca imā kho bhikkhave deva pariyesanā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ pariyesanānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapariyesanāti . [400] 154 devamā bhikkhave pariyeṭṭhiyo katamā deva āmisapariyeṭṭhi ca dhammapariyeṭṭhi ca imā kho bhikkhave deva pariyeṭṭhiyo etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ pariyeṭṭhīnaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapariyeṭṭhīti . #1 yu. terasamo . [401] 155 devamā bhikkhave pūjā katamā deva āmisapūjā ca dhammapūjā ca imā kho bhikkhave deva pūjā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ pūjānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapūjāti . [402] 156 devamāni bhikkhave atitheyyāni 1 katamāni deva āmisātitheyyañca dhammātitheyyañca imāni kho bhikkhave deva atitheyyāni 2 etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ atitheyyānaṃ 3 yadidaṃ dhammātitheyyanti . [403] 157 devamā bhikkhave iddhiyo katamā deva āmisiddhi ca dhammiddhi ca imā kho bhikkhave deva iddhiyo etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ iddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ dhammiddhīti . [404] 158 devamā bhikkhave vuḍḍhiyo katamā deva āmisavuḍḍhi ca dhammavuḍḍhi ca imā kho bhikkhave deva vuḍḍhiyo etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ vuḍḍhīnaṃ yadidaṃ dhammavuḍḍhīti . [405] 159 devamāni bhikkhave ratanāni katamāni deva āmisaratanañca dhammaratanañca imāni kho bhikkhave deva ratanāni etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ ratanānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammaratananti . [406] 160 devame bhikkhave sannicayā katame deva āmisasannicayo ca dhammasannicayo ca ime kho bhikkhave deva sannicayā etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ sannicayānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasannicayoti .
